title: sharing-client lacks direct serde dep that 7 sibling extension-clients declare — cookie-cutter divergence on canonical-template client family
description:
**Divergence** — production [dependencies] in 1 of 8 extension-client crates:
- crate-jmap-mail-client (canonical), chat-client, calendars-client, tasks-client, contacts-client, filenode-client, metadata-client all declare `serde = { workspace = true }`
- crate-jmap-sharing-client declares only `serde_json` (and the 3 jmap-* path deps); no direct serde

**Verification**: sharing-client/src/ does NOT use `#[derive(Serialize/Deserialize)]` or `use serde::` paths today, so the omission is harmless.

**Maintainer cost**: cookie-cutter divergence on the canonical-template client family. The moment a contributor adds the first `#[derive(Deserialize)]` to a sharing-client method-args struct (the most likely next change for any extension-client crate), they'll either silently compile against a transitively-reachable serde or get a confusing macro-resolution error. Either outcome is more friction than matching the canonical's dep set up front.

**Fix**: one-line addition to crate-jmap-sharing-client/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: `serde = { workspace = true }`. No runtime impact.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (already_fixed, skeptic-confirmed): crate-jmap-sharing-client/Cargo.toml:17 has serde = { workspace = true }, and the crate now uses it (src/methods/principal.rs:14, notification.rs:17 use serde::Serialize). Added in 8827090e. Side note: crate-jmap-metadata-client/Cargo.toml has no serde line now, which is presumably fine if cargo-machete removed it as unused. | check: crate-jmap-sharing-client/Cargo.toml:17 has `serde = { workspace = true }`, and the crate actually uses serde (notification.rs:17 has `use serde::Serialize`). The divergence is fixed.
